Variants.Content: Starfall City is located in the southwest of Dorne, where the turbulent river flows into the Summer Sea. It is the ancestral castle of the Dane family. It is far from Sunspear, but maintains its status by the river mouth, coast and road to the Crimson Mountains; the Dawn Sword tradition of House Dayne gives this remote castle a prestige far beyond its population.

Entry Starfall Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.
Entry Starfall They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Starfall If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Starfall A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Starfall They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
